assumptions: Tỷ VND; nghìn tấn. Công ty hư cấu Mầm Quế. Toy inventory cost pool and cash-settled forward, exports translated at transaction FX. No tax.

evidence.text: [Sản lượng] Opening finished stock10kt carrying40 tỷ. Current harvest50kt, qualifying production cost250 tỷ; homogeneous weighted average. No loss. Sales45kt, all delivered.
[Xuất khẩu] 30kt exports at $300/t, FX25 nghìn VND/USD; domestic15kt at 7 triệu/t. Sales all billed. Unit conversion kt×USD/t×kVND/USD/1000.
[Hedge] Short cash-settled forward on 20kt at $320/t, settlement spot$300, FX25 nghìn VND/USD. Gain separate P&L/cash, no hedge accounting.
[NRV] Closing stock NRV4.5 triệu/t; apply lower weighted cost/NRV. No opening allowance.
[Chi phí] Selling expense30, central25, depreciation10 outside production pool, finance cost8. No tax.
[Cash] Opening AR20, customer receipts310, production cash240, selling/central/interest all paid. Opening cash35, capex40, new borrowing30, repay15. Forward cash received in current year.
[Policy] No add forward notional to physical sales; operating cash uses actual collection, separate derivative cash. FCF=CFO−capex.

qas.question: Find total saleable finished tonnage available for sale.
Find total weighted-average inventory cost pool.
Find weighted cost per tonne in million VND.
Find matched production cost of 45kt sold.
Find remaining finished stock quantity.
Find NRV write-down on ending stock.
Find closing finished inventory after write-down.
Find translated export sales consideration.
Find domestic sales consideration.
Find total recognized physical sales revenue.
Find realized cash-settled forward gain.
Find PBT including derivative gain and inventory write-down.
Reconcile closing gross customer AR.
Find direct CFO including forward cash settlement.
Find implied closing cash after capex and debt flows.
qas.answer: Forward gain = 20×(320−300)×25/1000 = 10 billion VND. CFO = 310+10−240−30−25−8 = 17. Closing cash = 35+17−40+30−15 = 27 billion VND.

qas.question: Can export sales be repriced to $320 and the forward gain added again?
qas.answer: No. Export deliveries earned at spot$300. Separate forward gain10 applies only to 20kt notional; repricing all 30kt and adding gain double counts/misstates.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Trường giả lập Tràm Bút. Toy tuition recognition, research grant and endowment separate. No tax.

evidence.text: [Tuition] Opening deferred90, opening AR50. Current net billings650; earned tuition600 includes prior release80/current520. Cash collections620. No writeoff.
[Research] Grant cash180, verified eligible expense140 paid, ineligible expense15 paid from general cash. Earned grant140; opening refundable obligation0, unspent40 restricted/refundable.
[Other services] Dormitory revenue80, cash75, opening dorm AR5. Dorm expense50 paid.

[Endowment] Opening invested capital400; new gifts60 cash invested immediately; investment unrealized gain25, cash interest15 held separately. Scholarship payout12 restricted, paid from fund. No other investment movement.
[PPE] Opening campus800, cash capex100, donated equipment30 ready Dec31 noncash, depreciation50 included in teaching/admin expense520. Donation credited restricted net assets, not P&L.
[Cash] Opening unrestricted70, research/endowment cash zero. Teaching/admin cash paid465, bank interest expense/cash20. Debt opening300, borrowing80, repay40. No other flows.

qas.question: Find closing tuition deferred obligation from opening, billings and recognition.
Find ending tuition gross AR.
Find closing refundable research grant liability.
Find dormitory closing AR.
Find total earned operating revenue across tuition, research and dormitory.
Find closing endowment investments excluding retained interest cash.

Find unrestricted closing cash after capex and borrowing movements.
qas.answer: Unrestricted operating cash = 620+75−15−50−465−20 = 145 billion VND. Closing unrestricted cash = 70+145−100+80−40 = 155 billion VND.

qas.question: Find total cash including grant and endowment restricted balances.
qas.answer: Unrestricted cash = 70+620+75−15−50−465−20−100+80−40 = 155. Restricted grant cash = 180−140 = 40; endowment cash = 15−12 = 3. Total cash = 198 billion VND.

qas.question: Find closing gross debt.
Can restricted cash43 or invested endowment485 automatically be available for lender cash floor?
qas.answer: No. The floor uses unrestricted cash155, giving55 headroom; restricted grant/endowment balances are unavailable for general debt.

assumptions: Triệu USD; nghìn ore/metal tonnes. Mỏ giả lập Núi Gió. Toy physical production, saleable inventory cost includes UOP depreciation, closure provision and actual cash flows. No tax.

evidence.text: [Quặng] Ore processed800kt, feed grade2.5%, recovery80%, payability95%. Opening payable stock1.8kt carrying9m. Sold15kt, no loss. All output homogeneous.
[Giá] Gross sale price $7,000/t, treatment charge $200/t reduces net consideration. Royalty5% gross value.

[Sản xuất] Current cash-type production cost55m, mine PPE opening200m, remaining ore reserve10m tonnes at Jan1. UOP depletion based on current ore processed. Both costs allocated to inventory weighted average.
[ARO] Opening closure provision35, unwind2, revision +8 capitalized at Dec31, actual closure settlement4 cash. No depreciation on revision. No other movements.
[P&L] Admin10, finance interest6 separate from unwind, no inventory NRV write-down, no tax.
[Cash] Opening customer AR8, sales cash95, production cash53, admin10, interest6, royalty cash equals expense, closure4 classified operating. Capex cash25, opening cash20, debt draw40, repay15.
[Policy] No sales revenue for unsold output; weighted average includes opening cost; no additional expense on closure cash settlement. ARO revision noncash.

Find current UOP mine depletion from processed ore.
Find weighted available inventory cost pool.
Find matched weighted-average COGS on 15kt sold.
Find closing metal inventory carrying.
Find net sales after treatment charge.
qas.answer: Use the 15kt actually sold, not total payable production. Net consideration = 15×(7,000−200)/1,000 = 102 million USD.

qas.question: Find royalty expense on gross sale value.
qas.answer: Gross value of 15kt sold = 15×7,000/1,000 = 105m; royalty = 105×5% = 5.25 million USD before treatment deductions.

qas.question: Find closing closure obligation.
Find closing mine PPE after depletion, revision and growth capex.
Find PBT including royalty and ARO unwind.
Find closing trade AR after actual sale collections.
Find direct CFO including closure settlement under toy.
Can the 8 ARO revision be included as cash capex or the 4 closure settlement charged again to profit?
qas.answer: No. Revision is a noncash PPE/liability entry; settlement reduces existing provision. Only unwind2 is current finance expense among these movements.
